APPLIED AI / MARKET RESEARCH

Bring different signals into a reviewable pipeline.

A multi-source research and execution pipeline with separate collection, analysis and risk-checking components.

ProjectPolymarket Bot
ScopePublic implementation
StackPython · asyncio · Claude · FastAPI · WebSockets

The problem

Prediction-market workflows draw on market state, forecasts and changing news. Those inputs arrive on different schedules and need to be matched, deduplicated and evaluated before an action is considered.

My contribution

  • Connected market scanning to staged LLM analysis and contextual data sources.
  • Integrated weather data and news-event ingestion into asynchronous workflows.
  • Organized risk checks, paper/live execution paths and a dashboard for observing the system.

How the system works

Collect inputsMatch & screenAnalyzeRisk checksRecord or execute

Separate source-specific workflows. Weather, market data and news use different collection and analysis paths before feeding into the wider system.

Keep execution behind explicit checks. Analysis, risk management and execution are separate components, with a paper mode available for experimentation.

Expose the workflow for review. The dashboard and event flow make the integration inspectable beyond a single generated prediction.

What you can verify

The public repository documents the data pipeline, analysis components, execution paths and dashboard. The case demonstrates asynchronous integration and applied LLM orchestration.

Source repository

Scope & limitations

This portfolio case makes no claim of verified profitability or future trading performance. Outputs depend on data freshness, model behavior and execution conditions; live execution is distinct from paper-mode testing.
